subject: Invoice originator & delivery channel — secure bundle vs email copies

Cc: finance@greystone.com
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice delivery options and VAT evidence

Hi Irene,

Quick question as we ramp to prod: who will be the invoice originator on Redwood invoices (Redwood Inference or our account rep)? Our AP team prefers receiving invoices via SFTP or an encrypted portal drop (we have automated ingestion). Email PDF copies are acceptable only as a fallback.

Also can you include VAT proof and the PO on each invoice? We need a stable attachment (PDF or XML) with the PO number and breakdown for our tax team. I attached our internal PO reference.

Can you confirm the delivery path and whether Redwood can send both an SFTP push and an email-copy? If you require an onboarding tech contact, loop them in.

Thanks,
Sam
Samuel Quinn
Senior Manager, Procure-to-Pay
Greystone Inc.

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options and VAT evidence

Hi Sam — thanks for the clear ask and the PO. Short answer: yes, we support both delivery modes and can include VAT evidence.

Options we typically offer:
- Secure delivery (preferred): SFTP push or secure FTP-to-your-endpoint with filename schema (REDWOOD_<account>_<yyyymmdd>.xml or .pdf). This is what our integrations team recommends for automated ingestion and provides stable audit trails.
- Hosted portal bundle: a secure, per-account invoice bundle (ZIP) hosted in the customer portal with a signed timestamp and per-invoice XML + PDF. Useful if you want a UI and download history.
- Email copies: we can cc a billing email address, but we treat this as a non-authoritative fallback (no guaranteed delivery SLA).

We will include the PO on the invoice line items and attach VAT evidence as a separate PDF when required. If you prefer XML, we can produce the invoice XML per the spec (I attached our XML spec PDF for your SRE/AP team).

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm preferred primary channel (SFTP push or portal bundle).
2) Confirm billing contact (who should receive copies vs who should be the originator).
3) If SFTP: provide endpoint + credentials or coordinate with our integrations engineer.

I'll loop in our billing ops once you confirm — Laura will own the handoff.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_Invoices_XML_Spec_v2.1.pdf (application/pdf, 220KB)
